t: This is the Alan Turing Institute, the United Kingdom's national institute for data science and artificial intelligence. It was founded in 2015 and is largely funded by the government. Since 2025 it has focused on defence and national security. It is named after Alan Turing, the English mathematician and logician widely regarded as the father of theoretical computer science. He formalised the idea of the algorithm with the Turing machine, and his codebreaking work helped the Allies decipher messages encrypted by the German Enigma machine. He also gave us the Turing test, still discussed in artificial intelligence.
